lines.text: Ten crore rupees. Here's exactly what it buys.
Two point six crore puts nine prototype chips on the December twenty twenty-six shuttle.
Two point five crore is held back for respins, about eight re-runs.
Two point five crore keeps the engineering team going, to March twenty twenty-seven, and twelve months beyond.
The last two point four covers first approvals, tools and the lab, boards, and contingency.
Seventy-six percent goes to chips, respins, and people.
Ten crore buys first silicon for nine chips.
